title: Closed immersion of schemes
statement: A morphism of schemes $i:Z\to X$ [def-pc-scheme] is a *closed immersion* if $i$ is a homeomorphism of the underlying space of $Z$ onto a closed subset of $X$, and the map $\mathcal O_X\to i_*\mathcal O_Z$ is surjective. Equivalently (Stacks Lemma 01QO): for every affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] there is an ideal $I\subseteq R$ with $i^{-1}(U)\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R/I)$ over $U$; that is, $i$ is affine and induced on affine opens by surjective ring homomorphisms. A morphism $Z\to X$ is an *immersion* if it factors as a closed immersion $Z\to U$ followed by an open immersion $U\to X$ [def-weil-open-immersion].
